structure.unit: Requirements Applicable to Underground Coal Mines; Mine Construction

text.section: No person other than the motorman and the trip rider shall ride on a locomotive unless authorized by the mine foreman.
No person shall ride on a loaded car or between cars of any trip.
No person shall get on or off a moving locomotive or a car that is being moved by a locomotive.
No person shall be allowed to ride on top of a piece of self-propelled mobile equipment.
